capabilities: Import one or up to 10 Douyin share links into notes
Search Douyin by keyword and select results for import
Discover related content from a source link
Extract captions via OCR with local Whisper speech recognition as fallback
extras: Only Windows 10/11 is supported in the first release, and the plugin is a frontend to a separately installed local companion service that performs the Douyin access, OCR, and transcription. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It does not inherit source code or Git history from existing Douyin plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture Douyin content such as video captions, search results, or related recommendations into the vault.

requires.name: user-initiated Douyin login via local browser profile

summary: Imports Douyin video captions, keyword search results, and related recommendations into local Markdown notes via a companion service.
